# Final TinyCLIP evaluation corpus

24 new source originals selected by fixed Commons queries/license filtering, excluding prior source titles. `sources.json` records source page, author HTML, license/URL, attribution, downloaded bytes and SHA-256; query responses retain selection evidence. `benchmark.json` is the frozen, single-annotator relevance protocol. Artwork/manuscript originals04/20/23 are non-natural challenges:21 photographic originals+3 other visual originals, not24 natural photographs. Sparse category support and one annotator limit conclusions. Alternating originals assign12 calibration/12 test. Mixed content permits multiple correct labels. No original was selected/excluded using predictions. Related dark/blur diagnostic images were generated from calibration00 only and never count as independent observations.

Keep original author/license attribution when redistributing. CC BY-SA originals remain under the source's recorded share-alike license; transformed diagnostic copies inherit that license and are attributed to the local Hidden Data evaluation as transformations. No fixture is a production asset. Manifest width/height retain requested/source thumbnail metadata; decode dimensions can differ. The saved byte hashes identify the actual tested files. Commons429 errors were resumed without replacing existing selections.
